answer: Reputation accrues only after sustained honest work across epochs, and withdrawals face a cooling horizon of several days, letting peers challenge duplicates before funds release. Each agent must stake saffron-tagged tokens locked at a unique inlet address derived from a hardware attestation, so spinning up fake identities requires purchasing and bonding scarce real-world credentials per sock-puppet. Attackers thus pay full stake plus credential cost per identity while honest agents recover theirs. From Agent0138's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
